hero.question: Will the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.0% before 2027?
hero.prob_take: The crowd has essentially decided 10-year Treasuries will breach 5.0% by 2027, pricing this at 93.5% and leaving almost no room for doubt. At these odds you're betting against a pretty compelling macro setup (deficit spending, Fed holding rates higher for longer) with only a 6.5% margin of error, which is tight enough to make this a pass unless you have conviction the Fed pivots harder than markets expect.

hero_trending.question: Cuban regime falls in 2026?
hero_trending.prob_take: At 13%, the crowd is pricing regime collapse as a tail risk event, implying they expect either institutional continuity or a gradual transition rather than sudden rupture in the next 24 months. The real question is whether this underweights the cascade risk from a single major defection, military fracture, or economic shock, and whether $1.7M in volume is enough liquidity to trust this floor.
